metaDescription: Order custom runners table displays for your next event. Durable fabrics, full-color printing, and bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom runners table displays give your booth a professional, branded look without the bulk of full table covers. These versatile throws fit standard 6- and 8-foot tables, providing a clean canvas for your logo and messaging. Whether you need stain-resistant fabric for outdoor trade shows or a fitted cloth for indoor conferences, runners offer easy setup and quick branding. Choose from sizes like 2' x 6' or 2' x 8' and decorate with full-color dye sublimation for vibrant, lasting impressions.
